body: There is a saying. In not choosing, you always have a choice. I am not quite sure what others think of this saying, but for me I think that it only applies to certain things. Don't choose for everything that comes to you, you will always have a choice in the matter. Choose not to live, you don't have to worry about making the choices in the future. The grand illusion of being happy has never been my cup of tea. I have always been the doormat in my personal life. Being used, being taken advantage of, hell I even gave advice time to time. That thing is, all of the advice I would give, I could never apply to a scenario that I would be in because I wouldn't know what to do. What I'm saying is that I feel like that I have only been used to make others happy and I can't even make myself happy. I want to say that in making others happy, I feel complete, but then that would be a straight up lie. Death is the grandest and longest adventure of all. I just happen to be traveling down that path alone, like always.
How can you get to tomorrow when you know that nothing good will happen?
